title: Glowing bowl of noodles
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Steam -->
  <path d="M40 38 Q36 32 40 26" fill="none" stroke="#88ffcc" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M50 36 Q46 28 50 20" fill="none" stroke="#88ffcc" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.9"/>
  <path d="M60 38 Q56 32 60 26" fill="none" stroke="#88ffcc" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- Bowl body -->
  <path d="M22 55 L28 78 Q30 85 50 85 Q70 85 72 78 L78 55 Z" fill="#e8442a" stroke="#ff9e6b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- Bowl rim -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="28" ry="8" fill="#ff6b3d" stroke="#ffb380" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Broth surface -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="24" ry="6" fill="#ffcc66"/>

  <!-- Noodles -->
  <path d="M30 54 Q35 50 40 54 Q45 58 50 54" fill="none" stroke="#ffe88a" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M42 52 Q47 48 52 52 Q57 56 62 52" fill="none" stroke="#ffe88a" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M36 56 Q41 60 46 56 Q51 52 56 56" fill="none" stroke="#ffe88a" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M52 55 Q57 51 63 55" fill="none" stroke="#ffe88a" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M28 52 Q33 48 38 52" fill="none" stroke="#ffe88a" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Egg half -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="51" rx="7" ry="4.5" fill="#fff8dc" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="51" rx="3.8" ry="2.8" fill="#ffaa00"/>

  <!-- Green onion slices -->
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="50" rx="3" ry="1.5" fill="#44cc44" stroke="#88ff88" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="63" cy="53" rx="2.5" ry="1.2" fill="#55dd55" stroke="#88ff88" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="53" cy="49" rx="2.5" ry="1.2" fill="#44cc44" stroke="#88ff88" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- Chopsticks -->
  <line x1="60" y1="30" x2="45" y2="58" stroke="#c8a050" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="66" y1="32" x2="50" y2="58" stroke="#d8b060" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Glow effect on bowl -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="30" ry="12" fill="none" stroke="#ffaa66" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.4"/>
</svg>
